reviews.familyGate: The base Mazu-Baizhang event is one inherited family. The four retained sources count because each later master actively raises, appraises, reenacts, or critically comments on it; parallel recital alone would not multiply depth.
reviews.actorGate: Baizhang is the represented experiencer, not the utterer. Mazu is the case figure whose shout precedes the narrated result. Each retained later master owns the outer headword-bearing narration or raising.
